title: Personal Checking Overdraft Coverage Limits and Item Charges
content:
Discretionary overdraft coverage is offered only on the Personal Checking tiers marked as offering it. Where a tier offers it, the coverage limit is the deepest negative ledger balance the bank will create by paying items, the per-item charge is the amount taken for each item paid into overdraft, and the returned-item charge is the amount taken for each check or direct debit returned unpaid for insufficient funds.

| Tier | Discretionary overdraft coverage offered | Coverage limit (USD) | Charge for each item paid into overdraft (USD) | Charge for each item returned unpaid (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Student Checking | yes | 100.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 |
| Everyday Checking | yes | 500.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Interest Checking | yes | 750.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Premier Checking | yes | 1000.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Private Client Checking | yes | 2500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

Two floors sit under those charges, and each tier also publishes a count of chargeable overdraft items for one business day.

| Tier | Item amount at or below which no overdraft charge arises (USD) | End-of-day negative balance at or below which no overdraft or returned-item charge arises for that business day (USD) | Overdraft-item and returned-item charges combined for one business day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Student Checking | 5.00 | 50.00 | 1 |
| Everyday Checking | 5.00 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Interest Checking | 5.00 | 50.00 | 3 |
| Premier Checking | 5.00 | 100.00 | 3 |
| Private Client Checking | 5.00 | 100.00 | 0 |

Where a tier does not offer coverage, items that would overdraw the account are declined or returned rather than paid. A charge figure of 0.00 means no charge is written on that tier.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical).** On Everyday Checking, an item of 5.00 paid into overdraft carries no overdraft charge because the tier's floor is 5.00 and the item is at it; an item of 5.01 carries the tier's charge of 35.00. On the same tier, a business day that ends 50.00 below zero carries no overdraft or returned-item charge, while a day that ends 50.01 below zero does.
